framework.name: NIST SP 800-82 Rev. 3 — Guide to Operational Technology (OT) Security
framework.description: Provides guidance on improving the security of Operational Technology (OT) systems, including Industrial Control Systems (ICS), Supervisory Control and Data Acquisition (SCADA) systems, Distributed Control Systems (DCS), Programmable Logic Controllers (PLCs), Remote Terminal Units (RTUs), and Safety Instrumented Systems (SIS). Tailors standard IT security controls for OT environments across Purdue Model Levels L0–L5.
framework.author: National Institute of Standards and Technology (NIST)

controls.title: OT Account Management & Least Privilege
controls.description: Establish and enforce account management policies for OT systems, including role-based access control (RBAC) with least privilege principles for PLC programming interfaces, SCADA consoles, and HMI workstations.

controls.title: Remote Access Control for OT Networks
controls.description: Implement strict remote access controls for OT environments including VPN with MFA, session recording, and time-limited vendor access through OT DMZ jump hosts.

controls.title: Physical Access Control to OT Assets
controls.description: Enforce physical access restrictions to OT control rooms, PLC cabinets, RTU enclosures, and SIS panels using badge readers, biometric authentication, and video surveillance.
evidence_checklist: CCTV coverage maps for control rooms

controls.title: Default Credential Elimination on OT Devices
controls.description: Identify and eliminate default, shared, or hardcoded credentials on all OT devices including HMIs, RTUs, PLCs, managed switches, and safety controllers.

controls.title: OT Bastion Host & Jump Server MFA Enforcement
controls.description: Mandate multi-factor authentication (MFA) on all bastion hosts, jump servers, and privileged access workstations (PAWs) used for OT DMZ traversal.

controls.title: OT Event Logging & Audit Trail Generation
controls.description: Configure centralized logging for ICS/SCADA/DCS systems to capture authentication events, configuration changes, safety system activations, and network anomalies with tamper-proof audit trails.

controls.title: OT Log Retention & Forensic Readiness
controls.description: Retain OT system logs for a minimum period aligned with regulatory and operational requirements (e.g., 1 year online, 5 years archived) with forensic readiness procedures.

controls.title: Time Synchronization for OT Networks
controls.description: Ensure all OT devices, historians, and SCADA servers are synchronized to an authoritative time source (NTP/PTP) to maintain log correlation accuracy and event sequencing.

controls.title: OT Baseline Configuration Management
controls.description: Establish and maintain secure baseline configurations for all OT systems including PLC ladder logic, DCS function blocks, HMI screen configurations, and RTU firmware versions.

controls.title: OT Patch Management Program
controls.description: Implement a structured OT patch management program that validates patches in test environments before deployment, maintains rollback procedures, and accounts for vendor approval requirements.

controls.title: PLC/RTU Firmware Integrity Verification
controls.description: Implement cryptographic hash verification for PLC ladder logic and RTU firmware to detect unauthorized modifications. Maintain golden image repository with offline backups.

controls.title: OT Change Management & Configuration Control
controls.description: Enforce formal change management procedures for all OT configuration changes including Management of Change (MOC) integration, impact assessments, and rollback plans.

controls.title: Device-to-Device Authentication in OT Networks
controls.description: Implement mutual authentication between OT components (PLC-to-SCADA, RTU-to-Master) using certificates, pre-shared keys, or protocol-native authentication mechanisms where supported.

controls.title: Unique User Identification for OT Operations
controls.description: Ensure all human users accessing OT systems are individually identifiable. Eliminate shared operator accounts on SCADA workstations, HMIs, and engineering stations.

controls.title: Password Complexity & Rotation for OT Systems
controls.description: Enforce password complexity requirements and rotation schedules appropriate for OT environments, considering operational constraints and safety implications of lockout policies.

controls.title: OT Asset Inventory & Identification
controls.description: Maintain a comprehensive, up-to-date inventory of all OT assets (hardware, software, firmware) including make, model, firmware version, network address, Purdue level, and criticality classification.

controls.title: OT-Specific Incident Response Plan
controls.description: Develop, maintain, and test an incident response plan specifically tailored for OT environments covering cyber-physical attack scenarios, safety system coordination, and operational continuity.
evidence_checklist: IR team roster and contact list

controls.title: Safety Instrumented System (SIS) Incident Coordination
controls.description: Establish procedures for coordinating cybersecurity incident response with Safety Instrumented System (SIS) operations to prevent cyber attacks from compromising safety functions.

controls.title: OT Backup & Disaster Recovery
controls.description: Implement comprehensive backup and disaster recovery procedures for OT systems including PLC programs, SCADA configurations, historian databases, and HMI projects.

controls.title: OT Business Continuity & Contingency Planning
controls.description: Develop continuity of operations plans for OT environments addressing manual override procedures, degraded mode operations, and recovery time objectives for critical processes.

controls.title: Purdue Model Network Segmentation & Zone Architecture
controls.description: Implement network segmentation following the Purdue Model (L0-L5) using industrial firewalls, unidirectional gateways, and DMZ architectures to isolate OT zones from enterprise IT networks.
evidence_checklist: Network architecture diagram with Purdue levels

controls.title: Industrial Protocol Security (Modbus, DNP3, OPC UA, EtherNet/IP)
controls.description: Secure industrial communication protocols by restricting cleartext protocol exposure (Modbus TCP, DNP3), enforcing encrypted alternatives (OPC UA with TLS), and implementing protocol-aware firewalling.

controls.title: Encryption for OT Data in Transit
controls.description: Implement encryption for data transmitted between OT zones (SCADA-to-Historian, HMI-to-PLC where supported) using TLS, IPsec, or vendor-specific secure tunneling protocols.

controls.title: Safety Instrumented System (SIS) Network Isolation
controls.description: Ensure Safety Instrumented Systems (SIS) are physically or logically isolated from standard OT and IT networks. Prevent any direct network path between SIS controllers and internet-facing systems.
evidence_checklist: Air gap or unidirectional gateway verification

controls.title: Wireless Security in OT Environments
controls.description: Secure wireless communications in OT environments (Wi-Fi, WirelessHART, ISA100.11a, Zigbee) with strong encryption, network segmentation, and rogue access point detection.

controls.title: OT-Safe Vulnerability Management
controls.description: Implement an OT-safe vulnerability management program that identifies vulnerabilities without disrupting process operations, using passive scanning techniques and vendor vulnerability advisories.

controls.title: ICS/OT Malware Protection
controls.description: Deploy application whitelisting, USB media controls, and network-based malware detection appropriate for OT environments where traditional antivirus may impact real-time operations.

controls.title: OT Network Anomaly Detection & Monitoring
controls.description: Deploy passive network monitoring and anomaly detection tools capable of understanding industrial protocols (Modbus, DNP3, OPC UA) to detect unauthorized commands and process manipulation.

controls.title: Software & Firmware Integrity Verification
controls.description: Verify the integrity of all software and firmware installed on OT systems using cryptographic signatures and hash verification against vendor-provided baselines.

controls.title: OT Cybersecurity Risk Assessment
controls.description: Conduct comprehensive cybersecurity risk assessments for OT environments evaluating threats to physical safety, environmental protection, operational continuity, and national security.

controls.title: Process Hazard Analysis (PHA) Cyber Integration
controls.description: Integrate cybersecurity considerations into Process Hazard Analysis (PHA), HAZOP studies, and Safety Integrity Level (SIL) assessments for critical OT processes.

controls.title: OT Threat Intelligence & Information Sharing
controls.description: Participate in OT-specific threat intelligence sharing programs (ICS-CERT, ISACs) and incorporate threat intelligence into OT risk assessment and vulnerability management processes.

controls.title: OT Supply Chain Risk Management
controls.description: Implement supply chain risk management controls for OT systems including vendor security assessments, secure delivery verification, and component authenticity validation.

controls.title: Vendor Remote Access Governance
controls.description: Establish strict governance for vendor remote access to OT systems including time-limited sessions, full session recording, explicit authorization workflows, and dedicated vendor jump hosts.

controls.title: Security Training & Awareness for OT Personnel
controls.description: Provide role-based cybersecurity awareness and training for OT personnel including control system engineers, operators, and maintenance staff covering OT-specific threat vectors and safe practices.
